text.en: Rewrote the expense process guide into one clear page; has not mapped processes across teams.
text.hinglish: Expense process guide ko ek saaf page mein likha; teams ke beech processes ka map nahi banaya.

text.en: Mapped invoicing steps in detail and found duplicate approvals; draft documents contain minor formatting gaps.
text.hinglish: Invoicing ke steps vistaar se map kiye aur dohri approvals pakdi; draft documents mein chhoti formatting kamiyan.

text.en: Keeps shared documents current; prefers working alone over running review sessions.
text.hinglish: Shared documents hamesha taza rakhna; review sessions chalane ke bajay akele kaam ko tarjeeh.

text.en: Ran review sessions gathering input from five teams; final documents arrived behind schedule.
text.hinglish: Paanch teams se input lene wale review sessions chalaye; antim documents schedule se pichhe aaye.

continuation.en: {first} lists the first ten processes to be rewritten.
continuation.hinglish: {first} ka kaam: pehle das processes ki list banana jinhe dobara likhna hai.

title.en: Who leads the two-week quality review sprint?
title.hinglish: Do hafte ke quality review sprint ka lead kaun hoga?

prompt.en: Put them in order: first choice at the top.
prompt.hinglish: Inhe order mein rakhiye: pehli pasand sabse upar.

text.en: Reduced defect reports by a fifth with a simple review checklist; team feedback is given mostly in writing.
text.hinglish: Saral review checklist se defect reports ek paanchvai kam; team feedback zyadatar likhit roop mein.

text.en: Found the root cause of a recurring error; takes longer than average to close routine reviews.
text.hinglish: Baar baar aane wali galti ki jad pakdi; routine reviews band karne mein aurat se zyada samay.

text.en: Sets clear daily priorities for the team; has run fewer sprints than the others on the list.
text.hinglish: Team ke liye rozana saaf priorities tay karna; list ke doosron se kam sprints chalaye.

text.en: Good at tracking open issues; regression tests are not always rerun after fixes.
text.hinglish: Khule issues ka track rakhne mein achha; fixes ke baad regression tests hamesha dobara nahi chale.

continuation.en: {first} opens the sprint board for the team.
continuation.hinglish: {first} ka kaam: team ke liye sprint board kholna.

title.en: How should demo coaching sessions be shared?
title.hinglish: Demo coaching sessions kaise baante jaayen?

prompt.en: Share all 8 sessions between them.
prompt.hinglish: Sabhi 8 sessions inme baant dijiye.

text.en: Delivered a smooth demo to a prospect last month; answers to technical questions were vague.
text.hinglish: Pichhle mahine prospect ko sahi chalta demo diya; technical sawalon ke jawab dhundhle.

text.en: Prepared a demo script that new colleagues use; pace picks up under pressure.
text.hinglish: Demo script banayi jo naye sahyogi istemal karte hain; dabav mein bolne ki raftaar badh jaati hai.

text.en: Handles live questions well; setup checks before the demo are sometimes skipped.
text.hinglish: Live sawalon ko achhe se sambhalna; demo se pehle setup checks kabhi kabhi chhoote.

text.en: Strong on product detail; slides are dense and rarely tailored to the audience.
text.hinglish: Product ke vivaran par mazboot; slides bhari-bhari aur shayad hi audience ke hisaab se badli.

continuation.en: {first} books the first coaching slot on Thursday.
continuation.hinglish: {first} ka kaam: Thursday ka pehla coaching slot book karna.

title.en: How should the planning bonus pool be shared?
title.hinglish: Planning bonus pool kaise baanta jaaye?

prompt.en: Share all 10 points between them.
prompt.hinglish: Sabhi 10 points inme baant dijiye.

text.en: Drafted the annual plan's cost section on schedule; scenario analysis was limited to one case.
text.hinglish: Saalana plan ka cost section samay par likha; scenario analysis sirf ek case tak seemit.

text.en: Gathered input from every department for the plan; summary text needed heavy editing.
text.hinglish: Plan ke liye har department se input jutaya; summary text mein bhari editing lagi.

text.en: Built the timeline the whole plan follows; dependencies between teams were only partly mapped.
text.hinglish: Wo timeline banayi jis par poora plan chalta hai; teams ke beech dependencies sirf aanshik roop se map.

text.en: Challenged two unrealistic targets with data; the written challenge arrived after the first review meeting.
text.hinglish: Data ke saath do asambhav targets par aapatti; likhit aapatti pehli review meeting ke baad aayi.

continuation.en: {first} is thanked in the annual plan circulation note.
continuation.hinglish: {first} ka dhanyavaad saalana plan ke circulation note mein.

title.en: Who coordinates the annual team gathering?

prompt.en: Put them in order: first choice at the top.
prompt.hinglish: Inhe order mein rakhiye: pehli pasand sabse upar.

text.en: Ran last year's event within budget; vendor payments were processed late.
text.hinglish: Pichhle saal ka event budget ke andar chalaya; vendor bhugtan der se process hue.

text.en: Compared three caterers and negotiated a lower rate; there was no system for tracking attendance.
text.hinglish: Teen caterers ki tulna karke kam rate tay kiya; attendance track karne ka koi system nahi.

text.en: Prepared a detailed run-of-show that kept the programme on time; budget updates were infrequent.
text.hinglish: Vistrit run-of-show banaya jisse programme samay par raha; budget updates kam aaye.

text.en: Collected feedback from two hundred attendees afterwards; planning began later than the calendar suggested.
text.hinglish: Baad mein do sau attendees se feedback jama kiya; planning calendar ke sujhav se der se shuru.

continuation.en: {first} reserves the hall for the gathering date.
continuation.hinglish: {first} ka kaam: gathering ki tareekh ke liye hall reserve karna.

prompt.en: Put them in order: first choice at the top.
prompt.hinglish: Inhe order mein rakhiye: pehli pasand sabse upar.

text.en: Raised survey response rates to a new high; analysis of open comments was brief.
text.hinglish: Survey response rate naye shikhar par pahunchaya; khule comments ka vishleshan sankshipt.

text.en: Designed clear questions tested with a small group; reporting to managers is still to be learned.
text.hinglish: Chhote samuh par parkhe saaf sawal banaye; managers ko reporting abhi seekhni baaki.

text.en: Managed last year's survey logistics without issues; follow-up action plans were not tracked.
text.hinglish: Pichhle saal ka survey logistics bina dikkat sambhala; follow-up action plans track nahi hue.

text.en: Produced a readable results summary; limited experience with statistical breakdowns.
text.hinglish: Padhne layak results summary banai; statistical breakdowns ka anubhav seemit.

continuation.en: {first} sets the survey opening date with the HR head.
continuation.hinglish: {first} ka kaam: HR head ke saath survey shuru hone ki tareekh tay karna.

prompt.en: Share all 10 sessions between them.

text.en: Resolved the highest number of support tickets last quarter; handovers to the next shift are brief.
text.hinglish: Pichhli quarter mein sabse zyada support tickets hal kiye; agli shift ko handover chhote.

text.en: Consistently high customer ratings; escalation notes are sometimes missing detail.
text.hinglish: Customer ratings lagataar unchi; escalation notes mein kabhi kabhi vivaran kam.

text.en: Wrote the help-article templates now used by the team; response times slip during busy weeks.
text.hinglish: Help-article templates likhe jo ab team istemal karti hai; vyast hafton mein jawab ka samay khisakta hai.

text.en: Trains new agents on call handling; ticket closure numbers are average.

text.en: Answered most payroll queries within a day; the query log is updated in batches.
text.hinglish: Zyadatar payroll sawalon ke jawab ek din mein; query log batch mein update hota hai.

text.en: Built the common-questions sheet that cut repeat queries; accuracy checks on amounts are hurried.
text.hinglish: Aam sawalon ki sheet banayi jisse doharaye sawal ghate; rakam ki sahi jaanch jaldbaazi mein.
